_comment: PC build tools for PSOPlus-nx, pinned by SHA-256 (checked before use). Taken from sonic-riders-recomp's setup/toolchain.json (MPL-2.0), PC tools only. Nothing here is game data.

zstandard._comment: Python zstd module: tools/setup_extract.py unpacks the devkitPro .tar.zst packages with it (Windows' tar.exe cannot on many Windows versions). Hash: the one PyPI publishes for this wheel.

imgui._comment: Dear ImGui (MIT), the settings menu's library (runtime/src/menu.cpp), both targets. GitHub's source archive of tag v1.92.9b (commit f1cc2ae15e53a861a874c3034aae6798fde194ab); hash checked on two downloads.

llvm_mingw._comment: PC test build only: clang for Windows with its own headers and libraries (no Visual Studio needed).

sdl2._comment: PC test build only: window, OpenGL context, input and audio.
